Ordinary Ratification of remuneration payable to the Cost Auditors, Kishore Bhatia & Associates (Firm Registration No 00294) for the year ended 31st March 2027. He also informed that the Board had appointed Mr Alwyn D’Souza , Practicing Company Secretary, (CP No: 5137; Membership No 5559) as the scrutinizer to supervise the e-voting process and he was authorized by the Chairman to declare the results of the voting.
